question: Should ClawSweeper retain and publicly expose this persisted observability contract for the bounded legacy publication fallback, and should a controlled redacted deployed handoff capture be required before merge?
rationale: The branch is additive and has credible local runtime proof, but the long-term value and compatibility commitment of durable telemetry plus a public operator response for a fallback path require maintainer intent rather than an automated correctness judgment.

options.title: Accept the fallback telemetry contract
options.body: Approve the additive Durable Object and queue-statistics contract, then request or explicitly waive one controlled redacted deployed dispatcher-to-stats capture.

options.title: Decline the fallback observability scope
options.body: Close the PR as intentionally not pursued if public telemetry for the retained fallback is not a desired long-term product contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the fallback telemetry contract
recommendation.body: Approve the additive Durable Object and queue-statistics contract, then request or explicitly waive one controlled redacted deployed dispatcher-to-stats capture.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged direct-publication and canonical-state work established the retained fallback boundary that this PR instruments.
